description_en: Retrieves the supported search criteria for image repositories
description_zh: 获取镜像仓库支持检索项
name: DescribeImageRepoCriteria

parameters.description_en:
The search value for image repositories.

> This parameter supports fuzzy match for image IDs, tags, image instance IDs, repository names, repository namespaces, repository IDs, repository regions, digests, and repository types.
parameters.description_zh:
镜像仓库检索值。

> 该参数支持镜像ID、tag、镜像实例ID、镜像仓名称、镜像仓命名空间、镜像仓ID、镜像仓地域、digest、镜像仓库的类型的模糊搜索。
